description:
Incorporated in 1995, Lypsa Gems and Jewellery Ltd does wholesale & retail trading of Rough, Cut & Polished Diamonds and Gold Diamond Studded Jewellery [1]

Key Points:
Business Overview: [1] LGJL is in the business of trading and manufacturing small-sized polished diamonds ranging from 0.005 to 0.75 cents, and in the price range of 300 -900 US Dollars.
